top_signals.title: Two More Oil Tankers Attacked Near Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Two more tankers were attacked near the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, one in Hormuz and the other off the coast of Oman, Argus has reported, citing ship-tracking data and the Indian shipping minister. One of the targets was a Suezmax loaded with Iraqi crude, which had set sail on October 8, the Indian top shipping official said. It was hit by an unknown projectile that caused fire on board and, at the time of writing, two sailors were still missing.  The other tanker was a product carrier that was hit by a drone. That attack was reported earlier…
